'''Rod Latham Duel of the Fates v2.0''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds96.htm Duel of the Fates v2.0], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228002953/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds96.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
